documents.title: Effect preference Jan
documents.markdown: Luv prefers Effect 3 for the yumeoi domain layer. The team keeps Effect out of React components.

documents.title: Effect upgrade Jun
documents.markdown: Luv prefers Effect 4 for the yumeoi domain layer. The team decided to upgrade from Effect 3 after the RC landed.

documents.title: Effect stay Aug
documents.markdown: Luv decided to stay on Effect 4 for the domain layer. React components still must not import Effect.

documents.title: Editor
documents.markdown: Luv prefers dark mode in the editor at all times. Tabs are required in Biome output.

documents.title: Chat model Mar
documents.markdown: Chat will use GPT-5.6 Terra at high effort. OpenAI remains the fallback vendor.

documents.title: Chat model Jul
documents.markdown: Chat is pinned to GPT-5.6 Luna at high effort. Terra is only an escape hatch if citation quality is insufficient.

documents.title: Polling Feb
documents.markdown: Notion polling is scheduled every 15 minutes. SourceAgent owns the cursor for each workspace.

documents.title: Polling May
documents.markdown: Notion polling is scheduled every 10 minutes. Faster polls were needed after missed page edits.

documents.title: Anna leads Aurora
documents.markdown: Anna leads Project Aurora for the Hamburg launch. Luv works with Anna on the memory model.

documents.title: Aurora kickoff
documents.markdown: The Aurora kickoff meeting is scheduled on 2026-04-08 at 10:00. Luv and Anna agreed to ship M4 before the Gmail connector.

documents.title: Sam connectors
documents.markdown: Sam reports to Luv on connector work. Sam works with Cursor agents on the Notion OAuth flow.

documents.title: Alex reviews
documents.markdown: Luv reports to Alex weekly. Alex prefers short written updates over standups.

documents.title: Deploy procedure
documents.markdown: When deploying yumeoi, run bun run deploy:dry-run before deploy:prod. Always wait for CI to go green first.

documents.title: Citation rule
documents.markdown: Always cite memories with numbered marks in chat answers. Never invent a memory that is not in recall.

documents.title: Vectorize
documents.markdown: Namespaces for Vectorize embeddings are the user id. Embeddings use Workers AI bge-m3.

documents.title: FTS
documents.markdown: Keyword search uses Durable Object SQLite FTS5. Each user store lives in a MemoryAgent durable object.

documents.title: Ingest HTTP
documents.markdown: POST /ingest accepts externalId, title, markdown, and metadata. Ingest runs as IngestWorkflow on Cloudflare.

documents.title: API keys
documents.markdown: API keys start with ym_ and are shown once. Headless agents send Authorization Bearer ym_ tokens.

documents.title: M4 ship
documents.markdown: Luv and Anna agreed to ship M4 before the Gmail connector. MCP OAuth and the Agents screen are in M4.

documents.title: Gmail task
documents.markdown: We need to add the Gmail connector in M5. Skip attachments for v0 Gmail to keep ingest cheap.

documents.title: Meetings policy
documents.markdown: Meetings after 4pm are a hard no. Luv prefers written decisions in Notion over chat threads.

documents.title: Coffee
documents.markdown: Luv prefers oat milk in coffee. Anna prefers tea during afternoon planning sessions.

documents.title: Hamburg
documents.markdown: Project Aurora targets a Hamburg launch in October. Anna owns the customer interviews for Hamburg.

documents.title: Luv Anna meet
documents.markdown: On 2026-08-12 Luv met Anna about the project Anna leads. They decided to freeze the v1 memory schema before graph work.

documents.title: Rate limit
documents.markdown: Notion rate limit is about 3 requests per second. SourceAgent backs off when Notion returns 429.

documents.title: Provenance
documents.markdown: Provenance includes source, url, and timestamp. Memories without provenance should not be trusted as facts.

documents.title: One Worker
documents.markdown: We ship one Worker for UI, agents, MCP, and the API. Splitting Workers is postponed until the bundle crowds 10 MB.

documents.title: Workflows decision
documents.markdown: We decided to run ingest on Cloudflare Workflows. Durable steps survive Worker isolate restarts.

documents.title: M1 task
documents.markdown: Luv needs to ship M1 this week. The todo is wiring POST /ingest to IngestWorkflow.

documents.title: Obsidian vaults
documents.markdown: Vaults are local files so Obsidian sync is push-based. The plugin posts markdown to POST /ingest.

documents.title: Newsletter cloud
documents.markdown: This week in cloud: a vendor shipped a new object store region in Sydney. Subscribe for more product updates and partner webinars.

documents.title: Newsletter ai
documents.markdown: AI roundup: five startups announced retrieval plugins this week. None of them mention yumeoi or Project Aurora.

documents.title: Newsletter jobs
documents.markdown: Hiring digest: a marketplace is looking for a staff designer in Austin. Apply by Friday for the remote illustration role.

documents.title: Newsletter travel
documents.markdown: Flight deals to Lisbon start at four hundred dollars round trip. Book with the promo code SUMMER26 before it expires.

documents.title: Newsletter snacks
documents.markdown: Office snacks newsletter recommends roasted almonds and sparkling water. The vending machine in building B is still broken.

documents.title: Newsletter sports
documents.markdown: Weekend scores: the local club won two to one under heavy rain. Tickets for the replay go on sale Monday morning.

documents.title: Cursor agents
documents.markdown: Luv works with Cursor agents on yumeoi. Agent writes must still go through consolidation and embeddings.

documents.title: Budget
documents.markdown: Each source has a daily token budget. Extraction stays on Luna high until cost per document is measured.

documents.title: Unchanged chunks
documents.markdown: Unchanged chunks are never re-extracted. Hash-diff skips embedding when content_hash matches.

documents.title: Public launch
documents.markdown: Public launch waits on Gmail verification. Anna wants Aurora interviews finished before the launch blog.
